narr: Several storms trained over downtown and central El Paso which brought upwards of an inch and a half of rain to the area. Significant flash flooding was reported with several roads closed, walls knocked over and a sinkhole formed.
ev: Roads were closed around downtown El Paso near Wyoming and Kansas over to Interstate 10 near Piedras. Roads were impassable at some places.
